title: Cerberus (X4: Foundations)
intro: The Cerberus is a medium Argon frigate. The pilot flies it from the cockpit seat and fires its forward guns, while its turrets fight on their own. It can carry one small ship.

panels.name: Cerberus: seat and weapons
panels.text: Facts about the Cerberus that set it apart from other X4 ships: where the pilot sits and which guns, turrets and docking it has.
panels.context: All other controls of the Cerberus are the shared X4 controls of this guide.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The Cerberus is flown from a cockpit seat, as small and medium ships are. The pilot sits here and has all the controls of this guide.
controls.context: From this seat the pilot sees the HUD, the radar and the monitors of the Cerberus.

controls.name: Forward guns
controls.text: The Cerberus has two forward guns that point where the nose points. The pilot fires them with the trigger and aims by turning the whole ship.
controls.context: The aiming mark in front of the target on the HUD shows where to point the nose.

controls.name: Turrets
controls.text: The Cerberus carries four turrets, gun mounts that turn and fire on their own without the pilot.
controls.context: How the turrets behave (attack all enemies, defend, hold fire) is set in the menus, not on the sticks.

controls.name: Docking
controls.text: The Cerberus has room for other ships: one S docking pad. Small ships can land on it and be carried along.
controls.context: A docked ship travels with the bigger ship and can launch again later.
